title: Build your tag filter
copy: Group tags together and choose how each group matches. Groups can require every tag, or just one of them.

formula.empty: every character — no tag groups yet

selection.locked: This page always requires every group to match.

announced.all: Every group must now match. {{count}} characters match.
announced.any: Any group may now match. {{count}} characters match.

sets.title: Your tag groups
sets.maxReached: You can build up to {{max}} groups.
sets.overCap: This filter already has {{count}} groups, more than the {{max}} you can add here. Existing groups are kept so your results do not change.
sets.emptyIgnored: This group is empty, so it is ignored.
sets.nullifying: No character has every tag in this group, so nothing can match. Try switching this group to "Has any of these".

announced.any: Group {{index}} now matches any of its tags. {{count}} characters match.
announced.all: Group {{index}} now requires all of its tags. {{count}} characters match.

explainer.title: Two ways a group can match
explainer.anyCopy: A character needs at least one tag from the group. Use this to widen your results.
explainer.allCopy: A character must have every tag in the group. Use this to narrow your results.
explainer.sample: Example: a group with "Remove Bind or Remove Paralysis", plus a second group with "Orb Boost", finds characters that cure one of those two and also boost orbs.
